body_text:
A path in an open set $U\subseteq\mathbb{C}$ is a continuous
map $\gamma:[a,b]\to U$. It is piecewise continuously
differentiable if $[a,b]$ can be divided into finitely many
subintervals on which $\gamma$ has a continuous derivative. The
path is closed when $\gamma(a)=\gamma(b)$. Its parameterization
includes orientation and multiplicity.
